nodes.klein: to seize. he grasped; caught, seized, clutched, held, fastened; he bolted, shut. was caught, was seized. (a hapax legomenon in the Bible, occurring Job 26:9 in the phrase מְאַחֵז פְּנֵי כִּסֵא and prob. meaning ‘to close’). he settled (on the land). he caused to seize, caused to hold, fastened. was fastened.
